name: What are common water features incorporated into resort-style pool designs?

mainEntity.name: What are common water features incorporated into resort-style pool designs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resort-style pools often feature elaborate water elements to create visual interest and a soothing atmosphere. Popular additions include cascading waterfalls, natural rock grottoes with hidden seating, laminar jets, sheer descent waterfalls, and custom-designed fountains. Infinity edges (or vanishing edges) are also common for pools with scenic views, creating a seamless visual transition. These features not only enhance the aesthetic appeal but also contribute to the tranquil and luxurious experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common water features in resort-style pools include waterfalls, grottoes, laminar jets, sheer descents, and infinity edges.
